description:
No-Won, the CEO of a successful IT company, is known for his casual romances and playful attitude, but he's a scandal maker who doesn't cultivate deep relationships. When No-Won becomes embroiled in a business lawsuit, he meets Yeo Do-Young, the opposing attorney, in court. Yeo Do-Young is a cool-headed and rational, capable lawyer. She thoroughly corners No-Won and his company in court, securing a victory. During this process, No-Won becomes deeply intrigued by Yeo Do-Young for a simple reason: "That face is my style." Ultimately, No-Won signs a personal legal consultation contract with Yeo Do-Young, hoping to gain access to her. He then repeatedly visits her office, making excuses and disrupting her work. Yeo Do-Young treats him coldly, ignoring his tiresome projects. Ultimately, Yeo Do-Young makes the biggest mistake of her life, trying to get rid of him...

(Source: Lezhin, translated)
